### Motivation

This workflow is based on cleaning the `antigen-selected` databases (Ex: `S19`, `S20`, `S21`). 

To select the best members of each `antigen-selected` cluster, we need to find and draw information from the clonal family members in the `source databases` (library or cDNA). It is the distinctions between `antigen-selected` members and `source members` of each clonal family that is critical.

Because we cannot expect the highly-enriched and selected VHHs in the antigen-selected databases to always have closely related CDR3 regions, we need a new method to identify clonal families in the source databases from which they originated. 

This will be addressed in subsequent experiments, likely by comparing consensus CDR3s, median CDR3s, and median VHHs in clonal families.


```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringdist))
```

## Load Antigen-Selected Databases (S19 for now)

We will expand shortly to combine `{S19, S20, S21}` for re-cleaning (as they will have many duplicates and many of the same poorly-formed clusters).

### Load consensus database

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
cdb <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/cluster_database/9_L3_sh2_S9_min_threshold_clone-pass-consensuses15Mar24.csv",
                header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Subset only 19 for now
cdb <- cdb[cdb$f == "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",]

# Order by Dup_count
```

Unsurprisingly, these larger clusters are our "usual suspects!"

### Load individual clonal database

```{r, warning = F, eval = T, echo = F}
db <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/clean_results/19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

db$f <- rep("19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", each = nrow(db))

# Trim CDR3s
db$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(db$junction_aa)

# Translate
db$VHH <- translate_DNA(db$sequence_alignment)

# Trim
db$VHH <- substr(db$VHH, 11, nchar(db$VHH))

# Keep productive only
nrow(db)
db <- unproductive(db)
nrow(db)
```

## Initial logo-plots

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
## Initialize tmp for holding results
tmp <- data.frame()
cleaning_run <- "Initial"
tmp_res <- data.frame()

for (nm in cdb$cluster_id){
  if (nm %in% intersect(cdb$cluster_id, db$clone_id)){
      tmp_frame <- db[db$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
      
      ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
      unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
      unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
      
      # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
      median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
      median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
      consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
      
      # Pull entropy values
      CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
      VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
      
      # Count duplicates
      duplicate_count <- sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count)
      
      tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, cbind(tmp_frame$f[1], 
                                      tmp_frame$clone_id[1],
                                      duplicate_count,
                                      consensus_CDR3,
                                      median_CDR3,
                                      median_VHH,
                                      CDR3_entropy,
                                      VHH_entropy))
      
      if (nm %in% head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
          if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
          cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Overall Members (Including Duplicates): ", sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Unique DNA sequences: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$sequence)), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
          print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
          cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
          cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == median_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
          print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
            theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3,'\nCleaning Run: ', cleaning_run, sep = '')))
        }
      }
  }
}

tmp_res$id <- rep(cleaning_run, each = nrow(tmp_res))

tmp <- rbind(tmp, tmp_res)
```

### Cluster Dendrogram (Family Level)

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
strings <- tmp_res[tmp_res$id == cleaning_run,]$consensus_CDR3

# strings <- strings[!duplicated(strings)]

# Compute the distance matrix using Jaccard distance
dist_matrix <- stringdistmatrix(strings, method = "lv")

# Perform hierarchical clustering
cluster_tree <- hclust(as.dist(dist_matrix), method = "complete")

main_title <- paste("Cluster Dendrogram of CDR3 Clonal Families from: ", gsub("_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv","",tmp_frame$f[1]), "\n Cleaning Run: ", cleaning_run, "\nDistance Metric: Levenshtein", sep = '')

par(family = "Courier")

# Plot the dendrogram with labels
plot(cluster_tree, main = main_title, xlab = "DNA Read Count-Clonal Family Consensus CDR3s-Clone ID", sub = NULL, labels = paste(tmp_res$duplicate_count,'-C', tmp_res$V2, '-', strings, sep = ''), ylab = "Distance (Levenshtein)", cex = 0.4)
```

## Cleaning Implementation

### Construct Dataset with Initial Statistics for Cleaning

**We want:**

1. `CDR3-entropy`

2. `VHH-entropy`

3. `median-CDR3` (`CDR3-consensus`?)

4. `median-VHH` (`VHH-consensus`?)


```{r, eval = T, echo = T}
results <- data.frame()

for (nm in cdb$cluster_id){
  if (nm %in% intersect(cdb$cluster_id, db$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- db[db$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
  median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
  
  # Pull entropy values
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  ## Subset variables of interest
  
  tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_VHH, tmp_frame$VHH))/nchar(median_VHH))*100
  tmp_frame$median_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(median_CDR3))*100
  tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(consensus_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(consensus_CDR3))*100
  
  tmp_frame$median_CDR3 <- rep(median_CDR3, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$median_VHH <- rep(median_VHH, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3 <- rep(consensus_CDR3, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$CDR3_entropy <- rep(CDR3_entropy, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$VHH_entropy <- rep(VHH_entropy, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
  }
}

rm(tmp_frame, unrolled_CDR3s, unrolled_VHHs)
```

## Rule-based Cleaning (CDR3 length and Homology)

*	10 aa CDR3, `>60%` homology within databases selected on the same target?
  
*	6-9 aa CDR3, `>80%` homology within databases selected on the same target? (or combine CDR1/2/3 together and >60% homology?)
  
*	<6 aa CDR3, `100%` homology? (or combine CDR1/2/3 together and >60% homology?) 

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
tmp_res <- data.frame()
cleaning_run <- "Rule-Based"

for (nm in cdb$cluster_id){
  if (nm %in% intersect(cdb$cluster_id, results$clone_id)){
      tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]

      
      # Pull values for constraints
      consensus_CDR3 <- tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3[1]
      median_VHH <- tmp_frame$median_VHH[1]
    
      ## Enforce Constraints
      if (nchar(consensus_CDR3) >= 10){
        tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= 60,]
      } else if ((nchar(consensus_CDR3) > 6) & (nchar(consensus_CDR3) < 10)){
        tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= 80,]
      } else {
        tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology == 100 & 
                                 tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology >= 90,]
      }
      
      
      if (nrow(tmp_frame) >= 1){
        
          ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
          unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
          unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
          
          # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
          median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
          median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
          consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
          
          # Pull entropy values
          CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
          VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
          
          # Count duplicates
          duplicate_count <- sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count)
          
          tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, cbind(tmp_frame$f[1], 
                                          tmp_frame$clone_id[1],
                                          duplicate_count,
                                          consensus_CDR3,
                                          median_CDR3,
                                          median_VHH,
                                          CDR3_entropy,
                                          VHH_entropy))
      
      if (nm %in% head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
          if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
          cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Overall Members (Including Duplicates): ", sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Unique DNA sequences: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$sequence)), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
          print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
          cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
          cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
          cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == median_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
          print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
            theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3,'\nCleaning Run: ', cleaning_run, sep = '')))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

tmp_res$id <- rep(cleaning_run, each = nrow(tmp_res))

tmp <- rbind(tmp, tmp_res)
```

## Rule-based Cleaning Logoplots with Singleton Removal

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
tmp_res <- data.frame()
cleaning_run <- "Rule-Based >= 2 Reads"

for (nm in cdb$cluster_id){
  if (nm %in% intersect(cdb$cluster_id, results$clone_id)){
      tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
      # Drop Singletons
      tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$duplicate_count >= 2,]

      # Pull values for constraints
      consensus_CDR3 <- tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3[1]
      median_VHH <- tmp_frame$median_VHH[1]
    
      if (nrow(tmp_frame) >= 1){
      
          ## Enforce Constraints
          if (nchar(consensus_CDR3) >= 10){
            tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= 60,]
          } else if ((nchar(consensus_CDR3) > 6) & (nchar(consensus_CDR3) < 10)){
            tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= 80,]
          } else {
            tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology == 100 & 
                                     tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology >= 90,]
          }
      }
        
        if (nrow(tmp_frame) >= 1){
          ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
          unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
          unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
          
          # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
          median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
          median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
          consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
          
          # Pull entropy values
          CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
          VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
          
          # Count duplicates
          duplicate_count <- sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count)
          
          tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, cbind(tmp_frame$f[1], 
                                          tmp_frame$clone_id[1],
                                          duplicate_count,
                                          consensus_CDR3,
                                          median_CDR3,
                                          median_VHH,
                                          CDR3_entropy,
                                          VHH_entropy))
          
          if (nm %in% head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
              if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
              cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Overall Members (Including Duplicates): ", sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique DNA sequences: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$sequence)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
              print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
              cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
              cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == median_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
          print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
            theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3,'\nCleaning Run: ', cleaning_run, sep = '')))
            }
          }
```

## Statistically "Clean" Logoplots

Arbitrarily, let's try the rule where **we drop clones from a group if**:

1. The `median_VHH_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

2. The `median_CDR3_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

3. The `consensus_CDR3_distance` is below the `1st Qu.`

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
tmp_res <- data.frame()
cleaning_run <- "Statistical-1st Qu."

for (nm in cdb$cluster_id){
  if (nm %in% intersect(cdb$cluster_id, results$clone_id)){
      tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
      # Drop Singletons
      #tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$duplicate_count >= 2,]
      
      # Pull values for constraints
      consensus_CDR3 <- tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3[1]
      median_VHH <- tmp_frame$median_VHH[1]
    
      # Find thresholds
      vhh_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology)[["1st Qu."]]
      cdr3_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$median_CDR3_homology)[["1st Qu."]]
      cons_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology)[["1st Qu."]]
    
      # Enforce constraints
      tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology >= vhh_dist_thresh & 
                             tmp_frame$median_CDR3_homology >= cdr3_dist_thresh &
                             tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= cons_dist_thresh,]

          if (nrow(tmp_frame) >= 1){
          ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
          unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
          unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
          
          # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
          median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
          median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
          consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
          
          # Pull entropy values
          CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
          VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
          
          # Count duplicates
          duplicate_count <- sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count)
          
          tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, cbind(tmp_frame$f[1], 
                                          tmp_frame$clone_id[1],
                                          duplicate_count,
                                          consensus_CDR3,
                                          median_CDR3,
                                          median_VHH,
                                          CDR3_entropy,
                                          VHH_entropy))
          
          if (nm %in% head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
              if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
              cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Overall Members (Including Duplicates): ", sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique DNA sequences: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$sequence)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
              print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
              cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
              cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == median_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
          print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
            theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3,'\nCleaning Run: ', cleaning_run, sep = '')))
            }
          }
      }
  }
}

tmp_res$id <- rep(cleaning_run, each = nrow(tmp_res))

tmp <- rbind(tmp, tmp_res)
```

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
par(family = "Courier")

# Plot the dendrogram with labels
plot(cluster_tree, main = main_title, xlab = "DNA Read Count-Clonal Family Consensus CDR3s-Clone ID", sub = NULL, labels = paste(tmp_res$duplicate_count,'-C', tmp_res$V2, '-', strings, sep = ''), ylab = "Distance (Levenshtein)", cex = 0.4)
```

## Statistically "Cleaner" (no singleton) Logoplots

Arbitrarily, let's try the rule where **we drop clones from a group if**:

1. The `median_VHH_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

2. The `median_CDR3_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

3. The `consensus_CDR3_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

4. Must have >= 2 copies (that is, it must _not_ be a singleton)

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
tmp_res <- data.frame()
cleaning_run <- "Statistical-1st Qu. >= 2 Reads"

for (nm in cdb$cluster_id){
  if (nm %in% intersect(cdb$cluster_id, results$clone_id)){
      tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
      # Drop Singletons
      tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$duplicate_count >= 2,]
      
      # Pull values for constraints
      consensus_CDR3 <- tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3[1]
      median_VHH <- tmp_frame$median_VHH[1]
    
      # Find thresholds
      vhh_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology)[["1st Qu."]]
      cdr3_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$median_CDR3_homology)[["1st Qu."]]
      cons_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology)[["1st Qu."]]
    
      # Enforce constraints
      tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology >= vhh_dist_thresh & 
                             tmp_frame$median_CDR3_homology >= cdr3_dist_thresh &
                             tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= cons_dist_thresh,]

          if (nrow(tmp_frame) >= 1){
          ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
          unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
          unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
          
          # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
          median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
          median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
          consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
          
          # Pull entropy values
          CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
          VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
          
          # Count duplicates
          duplicate_count <- sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count)
          
          tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, cbind(tmp_frame$f[1], 
                                          tmp_frame$clone_id[1],
                                          duplicate_count,
                                          consensus_CDR3,
                                          median_CDR3,
                                          median_VHH,
                                          CDR3_entropy,
                                          VHH_entropy))
          
          if (nm %in% head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
              if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
              cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Overall Members (Including Duplicates): ", sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique DNA sequences: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$sequence)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
              print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
              cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
              cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
              cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == median_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
              print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
                theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3,'\nCleaning Run: ', cleaning_run, sep = '')))
            }
          }
      }
  }
}

tmp_res$id <- rep(cleaning_run, each = nrow(tmp_res))

tmp <- rbind(tmp, tmp_res)

# write.csv(tmp, file = "~/Downloads/Cluster-Culling-Experiments20Mar24.csv", row.names = F)
```

### Cluster Dendrogram

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
strings <- tmp_res[tmp_res$id == cleaning_run,]$consensus_CDR3

# strings <- strings[!duplicated(strings)]

# Compute the distance matrix using Jaccard distance
dist_matrix <- stringdistmatrix(strings, method = "lv")

# Perform hierarchical clustering
cluster_tree <- hclust(as.dist(dist_matrix), method = "complete")

main_title <- paste("Cluster Dendrogram of CDR3 Clonal Families from: ", gsub("_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv","",tmp_frame$f[1]), "\n Cleaning Run: ", cleaning_run, "\nDistance Metric: Levenshtein", sep = '')

par(family = "Courier")

# Plot the dendrogram with labels
plot(cluster_tree, main = main_title, xlab = "DNA Read Count-Clonal Family Consensus CDR3s-Clone ID", sub = NULL, labels = paste(tmp_res$duplicate_count,'-C', tmp_res$V2, '-', strings, sep = ''), ylab = "Distance (Levenshtein)", cex = 0.4)
```
